title: Signed SLAPorSLOP document
description: The envelope every SLAPorSLOP document travels in. Check the signature over payload's exact bytes before parsing it (README.md).

payload.description: The document as JSON text: the signed bytes

signature.description: Standard base64 of a 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the purpose prefix, a newline and the payload

key_id.description: First 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the public key
